title: A serialized Box trade (wire shape)
description: Source: src/box/serialize.ts serializeBoxTrade. This is the element of trades-history.trades and open-trades.trades (the DB-backed list). Obtained via a DIRECT call to the REAL serializer (JSON round-tripped): the /api/box/trades route needs a live BoxEngine + Mongo + a market feed to reach, so the pure serializer that produces the exact wire bytes is called directly. Top level and legs are CLOSED so an added/removed/renamed field is caught. The execution/reconciliation/depth blobs are audit sub-documents whose internal shape is engine-owned and intentionally OPEN (see per-property $comment).

margin_source.$comment: MARGIN PROVENANCE. Which model produced `margin`. null means the trade predates provenance capture; the four model names are enforced by a DB CHECK constraint (migration 008). See migrations/008_trade_margin_source.sql and tests/pg/marginProvenance.test.mjs.

entry_charge_reconciliation.$comment: OPEN by design: an engine-owned reconciliation audit blob (or null). Its internal fields are not part of the frontend contract; the contract pins its PRESENCE and nullability only.

entry_execution.$comment: OPEN by design: engine-owned execution audit blob (or null).

entry_legging.$comment: OPEN by design: engine-owned legging audit blob (or null).

exit_execution.$comment: OPEN by design: engine-owned execution audit blob (or null).

scanner_config_snapshot.$comment: OPEN by design: a FROZEN copy of the config the trade was taken under (BoxScannerConfigSnapshot). It is a settings audit blob, deliberately versioned by the engine; pinning every field here would couple the wire contract to internal config churn. Presence + object-ness are pinned.
